project.name: Guildhall
project.summary: WebMCP gives browser agents actions; Guildhall gives them dependable collaborators across WebMCP, MCP, and A2A.
project.ai_usage: Codex was the primary development collaborator for planning, implementation, testing, security review, UI iteration, deployment checks, browser debugging, and scale validation. The runtime itself requires no model-provider API key.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped design and implement the canonical protocol, cross-transport adapters, trust and recovery rules, production validation, and spectator experience under human architectural and release decisions.
